tests.name: bon8_strict_false_unterminated_string_exception
tests.intent: Probes if from_bon8 with strict=false throws parse_error.110 when a BON8 string is missing the terminal 0xFF before another byte.

tests.name: bon8_strict_true_unterminated_string_exception
tests.intent: Probes if from_bon8 with strict=true throws parse_error.110 when a BON8 string is missing the terminal 0xFF.

tests.name: bon8_strict_false_terminated_string_success
tests.intent: Probes if from_bon8 with strict=false successfully parses a properly terminated BON8 string with 0xFF.

tests.name: bon8_strict_true_terminated_string_success
tests.intent: Probes if from_bon8 with strict=true successfully parses a properly terminated BON8 string with 0xFF.

tests.name: bon8_two_byte_unterminated_string
tests.intent: Probes if from_bon8 with strict=false throws when a string pushes back two bytes because of a multi-byte character boundary check.

tests.name: bon8_allow_exceptions_false_unterminated
tests.intent: Probes from_bon8 behavior when allow_exceptions is set to false for an unterminated BON8 string with strict=false.

tests.name: bon8_stream_sequential_reads
tests.intent: Probes sequential parsing from a single stream where first value is terminated correctly and second is read afterwards.

tests.name: bon8_empty_input
tests.intent: Probes from_bon8 behavior with an empty input vector under strict=false.

tests.name: bon8_only_ff_input
tests.intent: Probes from_bon8 with input consisting only of a single 0xFF byte.

tests.name: bon8_round_trip_valid
tests.intent: Probes to_bon8 and from_bon8 round trip on a standard string to confirm canonical output remains unaffected.

tests.name: bon8_multiple_ff_terminators
tests.intent: Probes from_bon8 with extra redundant 0xFF terminators after a string.

tests.name: bon8_integer_not_string_unterminated
tests.intent: Probes from_bon8 behavior on an integer value followed by extra bytes with strict=false to verify non-string types aren't misreported as missing 0xFF.

tests.name: bon8_integer_strict_true_trailing
tests.intent: Probes from_bon8 behavior on an integer value followed by extra bytes with strict=true.

tests.name: bon8_boolean_value
tests.intent: Probes from_bon8 parsing of a simple boolean value.

tests.name: bon8_null_value
tests.intent: Probes from_bon8 parsing of a null value.

tests.name: bon8_array_value
tests.intent: Probes from_bon8 parsing of a basic BON8 array.

tests.name: bon8_object_value
tests.intent: Probes from_bon8 parsing of a basic BON8 object.

tests.name: bon8_sax_interface_unterminated
tests.intent: Probes SAX parsing interface with from_bon8 when an unterminated string triggers the new check.

tests.name: bon8_string_exact_boundary_bytes
tests.intent: Probes string termination behavior right at the boundary where bytes stop being valid string continuations.

tests.name: bon8_long_string_missing_ff
tests.intent: Probes a longer string missing its final 0xFF terminator followed by an arbitrary byte.

tests.name: bon8_allow_exceptions_false_unterminated_fixed
tests.intent: Probes from_bon8 behavior when allow_exceptions is set to false for an unterminated BON8 string with strict=false.
